scope: Authored synthetic software scenarios, not expert-certified industrial outcomes. Model fields are explicit test fixtures; actual trained inference is covered separately.

cases.reason: Safety-critical asset exceeds its approved temperature limit.
Compatible degradation evidence on a production bottleneck requires early review.
Strong anomaly on low-consequence ancillary equipment still needs inspection, behind safety-critical and bottleneck work.
Criticality alone does not establish degradation or authorize continued operation.
A required channel is absent even though other observations appear normal.
Stale critical observations cannot justify a low-risk assessment.
A model reporting normal cannot cancel a safety-critical observed limit excursion.
Verified moderate limit excursions justify planned review without inventing a model result.
